files.description: Playwright tests for the people feature: list columns and per-person counts/actions, add via modal (name + searchable-select gender + intl date input), edit with pre-populated modal and round-trip of saved details, confirmed delete returning faces to the unassigned pool, and the per-person faces view with face removal.

testContext: /people renders a .people-table (Name/Gender/Born/Faces/Photos/Actions); each row has a.person-name linking to /people/<id>/faces, two .stat-number cells (faces then photos), and [data-action=edit]/[data-action=delete] links carrying data-person-* attributes. Add/Edit use #addModal/#editModal (modal 'active' class) with #addPersonName/#editPersonName, a gender <select name=gender> hidden behind the searchable-select widget (click .searchable-select-display then .searchable-select-option; values: ''=Not specified, 1=Male, 0=Female), and an intl-date-input (visible #addPersonBirthdate/#editPersonBirthdate formats locale text into a hidden input[name=birthdate] on blur; en locale accepts MM/DD/YYYY). people_create ignores birthdate — only people_update persists it. Server flashes render as .flash-messages .alert-success ('Added X', "Renamed 'A' to 'B'", 'Deleted X', 'Person updated'). Delete and face-removal go through the global confirm dialog (#global-confirm-dialog + #confirm-dialog-confirm). The per-person faces view (/people/<id>/faces) renders .face-card[data-face-id] cards; clicking toggles .selected and a hidden checkbox; #remove-selected-faces confirms then submits #remove-form. Setup shortcuts: POST /api/people/create {name} → 201 {person_id}; POST /api/faces/assign {faces:[id], person:id, faceStatus:'ASSIGNED'} runs as a background task (taskq host required) — poll the person faces page for [data-face-id]. Unassigned-pool membership is read from /faces?threshold=1 by parsing each .suggestion-group's data-faces JSON (covers hidden clusters); face ids 1,11,13,18,26,37,41 are reserved by the face_assignment suite (they belong to Obama there) and must never be assigned from this suite. The 'No people yet' empty state needs zero people in the DB and concurrent suites create people, so it is not asserted. Unique Date.now()-suffixed names keep runs and parallel suites from colliding; afterAll deletes any leftovers via the UI.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/people.yaml after inspecting templates/people/list.html, templates/people/faces.html, routes/people.py, static/people/list.js, static/people/faces.js, static/searchable-select.js, templates/components/intl_date_input.html + static/components/intl_date_input.js, routes/faces.py (FaceViewModel/data-faces payload), templates/base.html (flash markup), and the existing face_assignment suite (API helper conventions). Validated with npm run typecheck and a green run (5/5) against the isolated environment.
